Sonal Iyer: Heads-up team 9: we're deploying a new billing policy next month: route-tiered credit rebalance + minute-tier smoothing. Not a price change, this is an allocation and invoice-smoothing update. :loudspeaker:

Sonal Iyer: TL;DR:
- Route-tiered credit rebalance: free credits and promotional top-ups will be split into route-level sub-credits (chat, embeddings, fine-tune, inference).
- Minute-tier smoothing: short transient bursts within a 10-minute window will be aggregated and billed using a smoothing factor to reduce noisy micro-overages.
- Surge reserve: accounts will get a tiny automatic reserve (1-2% of monthly credits) to cover cross-route small spikes; Sales can opt to increase for enterprise named accounts.

Liam O'Connor: quick dev note: smoothing is implemented at the metering layer as a rolling 10min window with exponential decay weight. It reduces per-minute peaks but preserves long-tail usage signals.

Priya Shah: Support playbook draft below (short answers):
- "What changed?" -> We now show per-route credit balances and apply a smoothing window on minute peaks so small spikes don't cause surprise overages.
- "Will I lose credits?" -> No. Credits are rebalanced across routes pro-rata at migration, plus a small surge reserve is added.
- "Am I being throttled?" -> We penalize only sustained overages. Short spikes inside the smoothing window will be absorbed where possible.

Sonal Iyer: Migration plan:
- Week 0: feature flag + read-only UI showing per-route projected balances.
- Week 1: dry-run migration for 5k accounts (no invoice changes).
- Week 2: full migration for all accounts; we emit invoice line item "credit_rebalance_note" during the billing cycle to show adjustments.

Liam O'Connor: API snippet to preview your new per-route balance: 

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits/preview?mode=rebalance"
```

Priya Shah: Add to KB: how to request a temporary cross-route override (Support -> Billing Eng). We'll accept requests for 60 days after migration for standard accounts; enterprise exceptions can request longer.

Carlos Mendes: Legal check: promotional credits are still non-taxable in current jurisdictions; Finance confirmed no change today. If tax treatment changes later we'll notify customers and add a tax-disclosure line on invoices.

billing-bot: Automated: feature flag created: billing.route_tier_rebalance.v1, owner=@liam, toggled=off, audit=bb-2450012345.

Sonal Iyer: Finance note: the smoothing algorithm may slightly shift invoice timing for high-frequency customers; we will surface a new invoice annotation "minute_smoothing_applied" when smoothing affected token lines. No net price increase expected.

Liam O'Connor: Telemetry requests: we need metrics: billing.rebalance.migrated_accounts, billing.smoothing.peak_reduction_pct, billing.surge_reserve_utilization. @eng-infra please add.

- @pri: KB & canned responses (ETA 48h)

Liam O'Connor: I'll post a short dev-ex note with curl examples and sample JSON in #devex by EOD.

Sonal Iyer: Customer comms: we'll email all active customers 72h before migration with a visible Console banner. We'll also enable a one-click opt-out toggle for Dedicated/Private customers for the first 30 days.

Carlos Mendes: Please include an opt-in checkbox for marketing/promotional credits so customers can opt to keep them pooled rather than split.

billing-bot: Scheduled job queued: job_id=job-2450012350, type=rebalancing-preview, est=24h.

Priya Shah: Example KB excerpt for customers: 

"How does smoothing work?"
Short answer: we average very short bursts so tiny peaks don't create separate overage events. Long sustained usage still bills normally.

Sonal Iyer: Thanks all. If anyone has strong objections to the migration timing DM me. We'll run the dry run and review invoice diffs before proceeding to full migration.

Liam O'Connor: small follow-up: confirm whether partners (resellers) get their own rebalance logic or passthrough. @partners-team please advise.

Priya Shah: I'll add a support tag and escalation flow for any billing disputes in the 30-day post-migration window.

Sonal Iyer: closing thread for now. Will post the public FAQ draft in #announcements tomorrow morning.
